name: infographic-item-creator
title_zh: TSX 数据项视觉组件，改布局不碰渲染主流程
tagline_zh: 在 antvis/Infographic 里加新数据项或改旧样式，不用翻整个渲染栈。
tagline_en: Add or tweak infographic data items without digging through the whole render stack. Item visuals live as.
desc_en: Generate or update infographic Item components for this repo (TypeScript/TSX in src/designs/items). Use when asked to design, implement, or modify data item visuals, layout logic, or registerItem composites.
why_zh: 按仓库既有 registerItem 约定生成组件，改动隔离在 items 目录内，不污染主流程。
why_en: Follows the repo's registerItem convention, so edits stay isolated in items/—no main-flow bleed, built for visual iteration loops.
limit_zh: 只认 antvis/Infographic 仓库的 TypeScript/TSX 结构；不生成完整页面或数据逻辑。
limit_en: Only for antvis/Infographic's TSX structure; outputs component + registration, not full pages or data logic—beyond that, wire your own renderer.
title_en: TSX data-item visuals, layout edits without touching.
